description: Implied volatility board: VIX and the other vol gauges with their one-year percentile. Newest reading plus past boards. Market data: numbers follow the connected account.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

since.description: Oldest date to include, like 2026-06-01. How far back you can go depends on your plan.
